threads.body: With no API-version override, google-genai 3 makes the shared `genai.Client()` scenarios request `/v1/models/...`, but the mock only registers `/v1beta/models/...` (`tools/gen-ai/mock-server/src/genai_mock_server/google_genai.py:444`), so these requests receive HTTP 404 instead of producing conformance results. Add `/v1/models/...` support to the mock with deterministic regression tests, then rerun the scenarios and commit any regenerated data. The same issue affects the sibling `openllmetry/pyproject.toml:6` and `openinference/pyproject.toml:6` upgrades.
